title: Entity overview
responsibility: Shows the contract, measurements, what uses this entity, what it uses, and supplied evidence.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.entity
inputs.description: Required entity name, removal state and optional last-held commit.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.relations
inputs.description: Required relationship data passed to compact relationship panels.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared contract rows passed to the compact summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared measurements passed to the summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.children
inputs.description: Required content snippet for evidence appropriate to this entity.

outputs.name: EntityOverview
outputs.description: Named overview tabpanel with compact summary, compact relationships and the supplied evidence content. Removed entities identify their last contract and removed-state relationships.
